currentParagraphText: “Oh... I get it,” Minaga sighed as he teleported over and put a hand on the King’s shoulder before the other Unique Lifeform could react. “To be a king yet not able to start a royal Lineage... you’re jealous because I can have as many mini-mes as I want, while you can never have tiny versions of yourself running around your legs, bringing joy and meaning to your life as you stare across the room and spot your beloved partner and mother to your little princes.”
